note: After Emerson's (1925) original description of the new species (in English), placed in the original under the subgenus Nasutitermes (Subulitermes), later assigned to Atlantitermes; both alate and soldier are fully described. The author noted that this species is smaller than N. osborni and has much larger ocelli, while the compound eyes are proportionally the same as in the latter.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval; covered with rather long hairs and a few long setae. Fontanelle pore slit-like, forked at the apex. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Compound eyes very large and projecting, very close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli very large and projecting, very close to the compound eyes. Labrum brownish yellow. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, median suture indistinct. Pronotum concolorous with the postclypeus, the sides slightly angular, the anterior corners rather acute, posterior margin nearly straight. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Wings dark smoky, with a pale stripe between the media and the cubitus. Abdominal tergites about the same colour as the pronotum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, oval in dorsal view, with a distinct constriction behind the antennal bases, the lateral outline with a shallow depression in the middle and generally rather straight; rostrum with 4 setae at the base and 2 on the vertex, without short hairs. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 smaller than segment 2, segment 2 equal to segment 4. Mandibles without a point. Rostrum brown, moderately long and slender, slightly upturned in lateral view; hairless except at the apex. Thorax pale. Abdomen coloured like the gut contents; abdominal tergites with a row of setae at the posterior margin and a few inconspicuous minute hairs scattered over the surface.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (mm): body length with wings 9.50—10.00; body length without wings 5.00—6.00; head length 1.00—1.03; head width 0.90; antennal length 1.80; compound eye diameter 0.33; pronotum length 0.50, width 0.73; hind tibia length 1.20—1.23; forewing length 8.50, width 2.50. Soldier measurements (mm): body length 3.00—3.30; head length 1.13—1.16; head width 0.57; antennal length 1.23; pronotum width 0.37; hind tibia length 0.77—0.80. Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana; holotype an alate, morphotype a soldier; described from several alates and numerous soldiers of the same colony.
